turns.query: A desk is writing a line on how Hong Kong's fine particulate matter moved from 2024 to 2025. Give them the territory annual mean PM2.5 for each year and the percentage change between them.
An editor attributes the 2024-2025 decline to North station missing clean spring hours in 2024. Check the objection, identify North's lowest-coverage month, and advise whether to withdraw the line.
